item.description:
• New Lock Dock: keep the Dock on the display you choose, and bring it back automatically when it jumps to another screen
  • New Mouse Shake automation: shake the pointer to run any tweak, like moving the Dock back
  • See and edit each workflow's tweaks right in Settings, and add or remove them in one click
  • Dock previews now show in a Liquid Glass panel, switch instantly between apps, include minimized windows, and bring the window you click to the front
  • Compress videos to fit under a size you pick in the notch

• New File Shelf: keep files and folders on a shelf in the notch, then drag them where you need them
  • New Rename Files: drop images onto the notch and they get named by what's in them (macOS 27 and later)
  • New Clean Up Desktop: move everything on your desktop into a dated folder, with your choice of destination and an option to reveal it in Finder
  • Open a tweak's settings right from the launcher with Option-Return

• Close Zeus right away with the Esc key.
  • Start typing your reply as soon as the Zeus chat opens.
  • Adjust Teleprompter speed and size with cleaner, evenly sized buttons.
  • Browse a simpler, tidier Packages list in Settings.

• New Convert Media: drop images or videos on the notch to convert them, like WebP or HEIC to PNG, PNG to WebP, or MKV to MP4, and resize, set quality or remove location as you go
  • Turn short videos into GIFs right from the notch
  • New Teleprompter: scroll your script in the notch, hidden from screen recordings and screen sharing
  • Remove Background and Unquarantine now open as drop zones in the notch
  • New Packages in Settings: download the full FFmpeg in one click for WebM, MKV, MP3, M4A and AV1 videos
  • New Acknowledgements in Settings lists the open source projects Almighty is built with
  • Compress Media, Convert Media and Find Files now run on Apple silicon Macs

• Meet Zeus, your AI helper: chat or speak to run tweaks, search files and compress media, using Claude Code, Codex or your own API key
  • Open the new Launcher to search and run any tweak or open apps from one place
  • Drop a folder on the notch with Find Files to search it by name or text
  • Speak instead of typing with Dictate, powered by on-device speech models
  • Protect your Mac in public with Anti-Theft Alarm, which sounds a loud siren when the lid closes or the charger is unplugged
  • Shrink images and videos with Compress Media and pick how much to compress
  • Draw on Screen, and highlight your cursor, clicks and keystrokes with new styles for presentations
  • Push your display past its usual peak with Increase Brightness and its intensity slider
  • Arrange displays and move windows into place right from the notch with Position Window
  • Enjoy new tweaks: Open in Terminal, Show Path Bar, Show Library Folder, Keep Awake With Lid Closed, Auto Clear Clipboard, Quit Apps on Last Window and Device Stats
  • Run automations when the lid closes or the power is unplugged
  • Use interactive tweaks in the notch, now with dark animated themes
  • Browse workflows and automations as colorful cards that are easier to edit
  • Get started faster with a new onboarding that sets up permissions, the Launcher shortcut and launch at login
  • See tweak results in a quick toast instead of alerts
  • Enjoy more reliable Dock, scrolling, keystroke and system toggles that stay in sync with your Mac
  • Requires macOS 14 or later

• Support macOS 27
  • Make Energy Saver toggle state persist reliably across restarts
  • General under-the-hood improvements

• Improve Launch at Login using modern system APIs
  • Update dependencies
